description: This Java class implements the AdHocWritePlatformService interface, providing methods for creating, updating, deleting, enabling, and disabling AdHoc queries. It includes transaction management, validation, and error handling for data integrity issues specifically related to AdHoc query operations within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: AdHocWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the AdHocWritePlatformService interface, managing CRUD operations and state changes for AdHoc query entities with validation and error handling.

methods.name: createAdHocQuery
methods.description: Creates a new AdHoc query after validating the input and SQL syntax, handling data integrity issues.

methods.name: updateAdHocQuery
methods.description: Updates an existing AdHoc query identified by adHocId, with validation and data integrity handling.

methods.name: deleteAdHocQuery
methods.description: Deletes an existing AdHoc query identified by adHocId, with error handling for data integrity issues.

methods.name: disableAdHocQuery
methods.description: Disables an AdHoc query (sets active status), identified by adHocId.

methods.name: enableAdHocQuery
methods.description: Enables an AdHoc query (sets active status), identified by adHocId.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity violations, specifically duplicate name issues, and logs unexpected issues.
